# @cortex-ui/sidebar-sidebar

Projects with their conversations and agents, live; hosts sidebar.actions@1.

- **Plugin id:** `sidebar.sidebar`
- **Slot:** `workbench.sidebar@1`
- **Build:** `npm run build` → `dist/` (`index.js`, `style.css`, `manifest.json`)
- **Test:** `npm test`

React, ReactDOM and `@cortex/sdk` are peer dependencies the workbench provides.

<!-- slot-contract:start (generated by ui/scripts/readme-contracts.mjs) -->
## Slot contract

- **Fills:** `workbench.sidebar@1` as `sidebar.sidebar`
- **Props:** none besides `slot`
- **Hosts:** `sidebar.actions@1`
- **Workbench state read:** `layout.sidebarCollapsed`, `projectId`, `sessionId`
- **Workbench state written:** `layout.sidebarCollapsed`, `projectId`, `sessionId`
- **Own durable state (survives hot swaps):** `collapsed`, `scrollTop`
- **Frame methods called:** `agents.list`, `frame.project.list`, `frame.session.create`, `frame.session.list`, `notify.history`
- **Topics followed:** `agents.changed`, `notify.changed`, `project.changed`, `session.changed`

Styles use the theme's tokens and primitives only (`ui/verify/tokens.mjs` checks). Nothing is
imported from the renderer or from another plugin: the package builds alone (`ui/verify/standalone.mjs`).
<!-- slot-contract:end -->
